instructions: In the image at screenshot: Is the paragraph text set noticeably smaller than the menu links and button labels on the same page?

criteria.true: The paragraph text is noticeably smaller than the menu links and button labels, as if the main reading text were demoted below the controls.
criteria.false: The paragraph text is about as large as the menu links and button labels, or larger, or the image shows no menu or buttons to compare it with and the text is at a normal reading size.

instructions: In the image at screenshot: Is the running text, the sentences people are meant to read, set so small that it looks like fine print, such as a footnote or a caption, instead of the main text of the page?

criteria.true: The running text is set so small that it looks like fine print, a footnote, or a caption, not like the main reading text of a page.
criteria.false: The running text is set at a comfortable size for the main reading text of a page, even if small notes or captions elsewhere are smaller.

instructions: In the image at screenshot: Would a reader have to lean in or squint to read the paragraphs, because the text is small for the page it sits on?

criteria.true: The paragraphs are small for the page they sit on, so a reader would have to lean in or squint to read them.
criteria.false: The paragraphs are large enough for the page they sit on that a reader can read them comfortably at a normal distance.
